title: Discovery records (Stage 0)
html:
Discovery records (Stage 0)

  • REPOSITORY_DISCOVERY_REPORT.md — the report.
  • SOURCE_REGISTER.csv — one row per source unit with the directive's fields.
  • FILE_INVENTORY.csv.gz — every file: path, bytes, SHA-256, kind, area. (gunzip -k to read; the uncompressed CSV is git-ignored.)
  • FILE_INVENTORY_SUMMARY.json — totals by kind and area.
  • SECRET_SCAN.json — secret-pattern scan result (pattern names and locations only).

Regenerate: python3 -I scripts/discovery/inventory.py /home/claude docs/discovery, then source-register.py and secret-scan.py.

title: Repository discovery report (Stage 0)
html:
Repository discovery report (Stage 0)

Founder Master Build program, Stage 0. Read-only discovery of the founder's workspace, 2026-10-26. Nothing outside empathia-technologies/ was modified. All Empathia data is synthetic.

1. How the discovery was done

step tool (in this repository) output
file-level inventory: every file hashed (SHA-256), typed and placed in an area scripts/discovery/inventory.py FILE_INVENTORY.csv.gz (36,385 files, 18.4 GB), FILE_INVENTORY_SUMMARY.json
source register: one row per source unit, with the fields directive section 4 asks for scripts/discovery/source-register.py SOURCE_REGISTER.csv (34 units covering 20,254 files)
frozen-release check: every listed file of every frozen package re-hashed, every archive re-hashed scripts/verify/verify-frozen.py releases/immutable-references/FROZEN_CHECK_STAGE0.json
secret-pattern scan over 29,624 text, source, log and caption files (names of patterns only, never values) scripts/discovery/secret-scan.py SECRET_SCAN.json
media probe: every video and audio file opened with ffprobe and joined to the media-rights ledger by hash scripts/media/build-media-manifest.py media/manifests/MEDIA_MANIFEST.{json,csv} (2,230 assets)

Excluded from the inventory: dependency caches (node_modules, .git internals, __pycache__, tool caches) and the machine's own top-level dot-folders (shell, SSH and tool configuration — environment, not founder material). The exclusion is in the script, not done by hand.

What the register's judgement columns are. Path, file count, bytes, folder manifest hash, last commit and tags are computed. Purpose, maturity, defects, distribution safety and next action are the builder's reading of the recorded evidence (release reports, audits, the capability register), cited where they come from. They are not an independent assessment.

5. The source register (summary)

The full register, with every requested field for each unit, is SOURCE_REGISTER.csv. Its distribution column in short:

distributable now? units
no — internal source or evidence all repositories and worktrees, inputs/, legal/, film production folders, kits, this monorepo
packaged, but distribution NOT AUTHORIZED the investor packages (2.5.1.1, 2.5.2 rc1, 2.5.3 rc1–rc3): page-API security is NOT VERIFIED — EXTERNAL TEST REQUIRED, and the owner's written approval is required
controlled technical review only the Private Engineer Editions (rc1–rc3)

6. Findings that shape the rest of the program

  1. The product is a browser demonstrator. Everything users can do today runs in one offline HTML file, on synthetic data, with authorization enforced in the page. There is no server, no database, no authentication service and no deployed system. The production starter in this monorepo is the first server-side code with real persistence and server-side authorization.
  2. The demonstrator's rules are real, deterministic code. Classification, design checks, commissioning applicability (94 definitions), result labels and lifecycle gates are rules, not machine learning. They have been ported to TypeScript (packages/commissioning-engine) and reproduce the demonstrator's output on 92 golden cases.
  3. No machine-learning model exists. No dataset, training script, model file or ML library is present in founder material. PyTorch is not installed and cannot be installed here (no package-registry access). Any model work must start as a labelled synthetic prototype.
  4. No integration is connected. The 83-entry integration registry is catalogue-only (MOCKED_UI_ONLY, NOT_CONFIGURED).
  5. Independent assurance is thinner than the word "independent" suggests. The 2.5.x "independent audits" were performed by a separate AI reviewer that did not build the work, under read-only rules. That is a useful second opinion, but it is not a third-party audit by a human organization. This program reports it as separate-AI review and keeps INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED unclaimed. The external page-API security assessment (2.5.2 and 2.5.3) is still outstanding.
  6. Media rights are mostly not established. 270 of 310 ledgered assets are UNVERIFIED or EXCLUDED, and 1,893 probed media files are not in the ledger at all (NOT_IN_LEDGER, treated as not distributable). The films can be watched by the founder; none may be distributed until rights are VERIFIED for a channel.
  7. Chain of title needs counsel. Founder-supplied inputs include a Field Intelligence v1.3 collector (PowerShell), an original commissioning workbook, design packages and prompt kits whose origin (personal work, workplace, or another tool) is not recorded. They are flagged for legal review, not asserted.
  8. Editable design sources do not exist outside code. The design system's source of truth is the demonstrator CSS (Aurora). The token file in packages/design-tokens is extracted from it.

7. Recommended next engineering actions (in program order)

stage action
1–2 Founder Studio over the existing demonstrator (founder build from the 2.5.4 branch), the frozen editions, the films and the documents
3 source normalization: domain types, extracted rule data, ported engines with parity tests (started)
4 production starter: PostgreSQL schema and migrations, authenticated API, server-side authorization, the vertical slice, outbox
5 engine inventory; relationship and assurance engines; a labelled synthetic ML prototype only where justified
6–7 media manifest and rights classification; design system; blueprint documents; IP provenance vault
8–10 clean-environment QA, candidate packages and audit instructions, completion report

Nothing in this report authorizes distribution.
